name: Captain Technocast Limited
about: Captain Technocast Limited manufactures and sells investment casting products in India. The company offers casting products, including industrial valve, industrial pump, firefighting equipment, structure and hardware, automobile, engineering and automation, power plant boiler parts, building and water treatment parts, piping and clamping parts, and lost wax, as well as feinguss and micro fusion. It sells its products in various steel forms, such carbon, alloy, super alloy, non-ferrous, stainless, and super duplex. The company exports its products in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Italy, Germany, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, Mexico, Australia, and the Asia-Pacific region. Captain Technocast Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Rajkot, India.
